question: How is the fifteenth ground related to the three powers?
premises: The fifteenth ground has its own nature.
Three powers of the Lord were described before.
inference: The fifteenth ground is explained through the three previously described powers.
uncertainties: Exact referent of svaṃ is context-dependent.
plain_english: Its own nature is the fifteenth; that ground is fifteenth-natured, for the three powers of the Lord were described before.
